Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

opinion — what you think about something. Example: That is my opinion.
preference — the thing you like more. Example: My preference is tea.
culture — the way of life of a people. Example: In my culture we eat late.
choice — the act of choosing. Example: It is your choice.
favorite — the one you like most. Example: My favorite food is pasta.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I think ... because ...
• My favourite ... is ...
• I prefer ... to ...
• In my culture ...
• That is my opinion.
